sources.title: Zelenskyy urges the U.S. to pressure Putin, calling Trump's 'my friend' remark strange
Zelenskyy urges US to pressure Putin and questions Trump’s reference to Putin as a ‘friend’

en.title: Zelenskyy urges U.S. to pressure Putin, questions Trump's 'friend' remark
en.dek: Zelenskyy urges U.S. to pressure Putin, calling Trump's 'my friend' remark strange
facts: Zelenskyy urged the U.S. to pressure Putin
Zelenskyy called Trump's reference to Putin as 'my friend' strange
Both leaders made public statements about Putin on November 27, 2026
body: Zelenskyy urged the U.S. to pressure Russian President Vladimir Putin, stating such action is necessary to address the conflict. According to PBS, he called Trump's reference to Putin as 'my friend' strange.
AP News reported that Zelenskyy questioned Trump's characterization of Putin as a friend, suggesting it is inconsistent with the reality of the conflict.
en.context: Zelenskyy and Trump have both made recent public statements referencing Putin, as noted by PBS and AP News.

de.title: Selenski drängt USA, Putin zu drängen, hinterfragt Trumps „Freund“-Äußerung
de.dek: Selenski drängt die USA, Putin Druck auszuüben, und nennt Trumps „Mein Freund“-Äußerung seltsam
facts: Selenski forderte die USA auf, Putin Druck auszuüben
Selenski nannte Trumps Bezugnahme auf Putin als „Mein Freund“ seltsam
Beide Führer machten öffentliche Aussagen über Putin am 27. November 2026
body: Selenskyj drängt die USA, russischen Präsidenten Wladimir Putin Druck auszuüben, und erklärte, dies sei notwendig, um den Konflikt zu lösen. Nach Angaben von PBS nannte er Trumps Bezugnahme auf Putin als „meinen Freund“ seltsam.
Nach einem Bericht von AP News fragte Selenskyj Trumps Charakterisierung Putins als Freund an und deutete an, dass dies unvereinbar mit der Realität des Konflikts sei.
de.context: Selenski und Trump haben beide kürzlich öffentliche Aussagen über Putin getätigt, wie von PBS und AP News berichtet

pt.title: Zelenskyy apela aos EUA para pressionar Putin e questiona comentário de Trump sobre ser 'amigo'
pt.dek: Zelenskyy urge os EUA a pressionar Putin, considerando estranha a referência de Trump a Putin como 'meu amigo'
facts: Zelenskyy apelou aos EUA para pressionar Putin
Zelenskyy considerou estranha a referência de Trump a Putin como 'meu amigo'
Ambos os líderes fizeram declarações públicas sobre Putin a 27 de novembro de 2026
body: Zelenski pediu aos EUA que pressionem o presidente russo, Vladimir Putin, afirmando que tal ação é necessária para resolver o conflito. Segundo a PBS, ele chamou a referência de Trump a Putin de "meu amigo" de estranho.
A AP News reportou que Zelenski questionou a caracterização de Trump de Putin como amigo, sugerindo que isso é inconsistente com a realidade do conflito.
pt.context: Zelenskyy e Trump fizeram ambos declarações públicas recentes referindo-se a Putin, conforme noticiado pela PBS e AP News.

zh.title: 泽连斯基敦促美国向普京施压 质疑特朗普“朋友”言论
zh.dek: 泽连斯基呼吁美国向普京施压 称特朗普称普京为“我的朋友”言论奇怪
facts: 泽连斯基敦促美国向普京施压
泽连斯基称特朗普将普京称为“我的朋友”的言论奇怪
两国领导人均于2026年11月27日就普京发表公开声明
body: 泽连斯基呼吁美国对俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京施压，称此举有必要解决冲突。据PBS报道，他称特朗普将普京称为“我的朋友”很奇怪。
美联社报道称，泽连斯基质疑特朗普将普京描述为朋友的说法，认为这与冲突的现实不符。
zh.context: PBS和美联社报道称，泽连斯基和特朗普近期均就普京发表了公开声明

ja.title: ゼレンスキー、プーチンへの米国の圧力を訴え、トランプ氏の「友人」発言を疑問視
ja.dek: ゼレンスキー、トランプ氏の「私の友人」という発言を不思議がる
facts: ゼレンスキーが米国にプーチンへの圧力を求めた
ゼレンスキーがトランプ氏のプーチンを「私の友人」と呼んだことを不思議がった
両指導者が2026年11月27日にプーチンについて公的な声明を発表
body: ゼレンスキー氏は、ロシアのウラジーミル・プーチン大統領に対する米国の圧力を訴え、その対応が紛争の解決に不可欠であると述べた。PBSによると、彼はトランプ氏がプーチンを「私の友人」と呼んだことに対し、奇妙だと語った。
AP通信は、ゼレンスキー氏がトランプ氏によるプーチンを「友人」との呼び方を疑問視し、それが紛争の実情と整合しないと示唆したと報じた。
ja.context: ゼレンスキーとトランプ氏が最近、プーチンを言及する公的な声明を発表したとして、PBSとAPニュースで報じられている

problemsFixed: Facts not in sources: 'Zelenskyy called Trump's reference to Putin as "my friend' strange' is paraphrased from PBS, but the source text only says 'Zelenskyy urges the U.S. to pressure Putin, calling Trump's "my friend" remark strange'. The draft adds unsupported claims about 'consistently called for stronger international support' and 'complex relationship'.
Loaded language: 'The comments highlight the differing approaches... among political figures' is evaluative filler.

No attribution for AP claim: 'Trump has previously referred to Putin as a friend' is stated as fact without citing AP, which only says 'Zelenskyy urges US to pressure Putin and questions Trump's reference to Putin as a friend'.
Repetitive structure: body paragraphs open with 'Zelenskyy' and 'Trump' in identical pattern.
Summary sentence at end of body: 'The comments highlight...' is an evaluative wrap prohibited by rule 12.
Headline exceeds 90 characters and uses colon-adjacent phrasing.
